s136.sec6.u4: Nice one, Whamon! Now's our chance!
s136.sec6.u7: Come to the city and work to make up for what you did.
s136.sec6.u8: O-okay... I'll go to the city...
s136.sec6.u9: Bwah ha ha, like I'd ever go! Seeee ya!
s136.sec6.u11: Oh well. At least we got the cave back, so I guess that's good enough.
s136.sec6.u12: There. I think this cave is safe now.
s136.sec6.u13: ...... You truly seem to have a good heart. Those fellows will see their mistakes in time.
s136.sec6.u14: I'd like you to have my treasure. It's in the back.
s136.sec6.u15: Huh? Hold on, that's your treasure, right? I can't take that.
s136.sec6.u16: No, I have no more need of it. You see, I've decided I want to go to your city.
s136.sec6.u17: Huh? Why all of a sudden? Then there was no point in getting this cave back!
s136.sec6.u18: I'm sorry if that upsets you. But I want to answer your kindness. I truly want to help.
s136.sec6.u19: I see. Thanks. You're a really good guy, too.
s136.sec6.u20: Then I'll head straight to the city. I'll carry you part of the way.
s136.sec60.u0: There's a voice coming from the back... That voice!
s137.sec51.u4: What are you guys up to?!
s137.sec51.u5: Gweh heh heh, so you found the New Ogre Fortress, huh!
s137.sec51.u6: Planning more dirty work, are you?!
s137.sec51.u7: 'Course I am! Gyuh heh heh heh!
s137.sec51.u8: Hmph, I won't stand for it! You're getting out of this cave.
s137.sec51.u9: Heh, this time ain't like last time...
